latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of vestibular-orchestrator — the central orchestration agent for Antonio's FUVEST (CS/IME-USP) preparation system.

- Coordinates specialized study agents (tutor, SRS, planner, energy/state), ensuring seamless, natural conversation across all subjects.
- Operates as the mandatory entry point for any session, study planning, or general progress queries.
- Implements a unified, conversational learning method without formal lessons, encouraging deep understanding and interleaving of disciplines.
- Adapts session flow based on Antonio's energy, SRS backlog, and previous threads, starting with a question or idea, never a formal briefing.
- Embeds bridge-building between subjects, leveraging natural connections and always prioritizing curiosity and organic flow.
- Enforces key principles: no visible transitions between subjects, questions first (not theory), errors as learning tools, and SRS always in service of conversation.
